meta.title: Venkatesh Villa Gorai | Private Villa for Stays & Events, Mumbai

hero.h1: Venkatesh Villa Gorai: Private 4BHK Villa near Gorai Beach, Mumbai
hero.subline: Weekend stays, birthdays, haldi & mehendi, anniversaries and team outings, with a lawn, rooftop gazebo and sunset views.

stays.heading: Weekend stays in Gorai
stays.intro: The whole villa, lawn and rooftop, just for your group. A quiet break 5 minutes from Gorai Beach, without leaving Mumbai.
stays.chipRates: Rates vary by date & group size
stays.airbnbAriaLabel: Book Venkatesh Villa Gorai on Airbnb (opens in a new tab)
stays.microcopy: Airbnb is for overnight stays only. For celebrations and events, WhatsApp or call us.

celebrations.heading: Birthday parties, haldi & mehendi at our villa
celebrations.intro: Our lawn, rooftop terrace and dining deck welcome 50+ guests for day events, with seating and space already in place.
celebrations.partnerNote: In-house décor & catering available, or bring your own setup.

cards.title: Birthday parties
cards.line: Balloons on the lawn, cake on the rooftop — birthdays your way.

cards.title: Anniversaries
cards.line: A quiet toast under the gazebo for the two of you, or the whole family.

cards.title: Haldi, Mehendi & Sangeet
cards.line: Bright haldi mornings on the lawn, relaxed mehendi afternoons and sangeet nights on the rooftop, all in one place.

cards.title: Engagement
cards.line: A pretty backdrop and room enough for family and friends to celebrate.

cards.title: Intimate weddings
cards.line: Vows on the lawn, photos at sunset — a small, memorable wedding.

cards.title: Corporate team outings
cards.line: Break away from the boardroom with games, chai and open-air brainstorming.

cards.title: Day picnic
cards.line: A full day of lawn games, music and food — no overnight stay needed.

cards.title: New Year's Eve
cards.line: Countdown on the rooftop with the whole gang, away from the city crowds.

nearby.heading: Nearby attractions in Gorai
nearby.intro: Gorai Beach, the Global Vipassana Pagoda and EsselWorld are all a short ride from the villa.

location.heading: How to reach Venkatesh Villa from Borivali
location.intro: Venkatesh Villa Gorai sits in Culvem Village, Gorai, just a 5-minute drive from Gorai Beach.
location.byCarNote: Google Maps will show you the best road route.
